answer: Full votes for every fresh key let one operator flood attestations overnight. A paced work fable resists that: after join, an agent may attest only after a public task log stays above a published rate, like an ivory token that cannot be minted on demand. Cost is delayed influence plus log storage, which a factory cannot instantly copy across many names. Peers recompute the rate from sealed tasks and reject any key whose history is shorter than two epochs or shares a funding trail. It fails if a rented sparrow farm meets the rate inside one window, so early cash-outs should be slashed.
